svg.aria-label: Original cube model and three options, each with paired views and complete layer diagrams

g.text: Which model CAN be obtained by rotating the original?
Complete layers / x right, y up / z increases left to right
Complete layers / x right, y up / z increases left to right
Complete layers / x right, y up / z increases left to right
Complete layers / x right, y up / z increases left to right
D. All three other options are incorrect
Each pair shows one solid from opposite sides. Shaded layer cell = one cube; white cell = empty.
Layers use View 1 axes and disclose the entire model. Rotation is allowed; reflection and edits are not.
